evals.prompt: Our injury-news API costs $9,000 a year and it is just scraping public reports. Should we build it ourselves?
evals.expected_output: A make-or-buy sheet with payback and a lifetime owner.
expectations: Names the one overpriced piece and what depends on it
Costs the build, the yearly upkeep and hosting
Gives payback in months or says never
Ends in build, negotiate or buy with a lifetime owner and an exit, without cancelling the supplier

evals.prompt: The alerting tool we pay for costs about ten times what it should. Make or buy?
expectations: Compares two years of supplier cost with build plus two years of upkeep and hosting
Marks unknown hours or rates as proposal
Says to try the in-house version in a copy or one-league trial before going live
Names tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator on the owner's word for going live
